_meta.what: Formula E sweep run on 5 Sep 2026 in-session (the MD asked for more FE coverage — the log had ~35 FE rows in five months). Each row is a REAL 2026 capital or identity event found by live web search on that date, with the Tier-1/2 source the search surfaced. Rows import as historical / unverified (needs_review) through intel.backfill, exactly like the n8n log: they are leads with a headline and a source, not verified cases. Build any of them into a full case with `python -m intel.rebuild "<Company>" --date <Date>`.
_meta.how_scored: Same five /20 dimensions, scored honestly from what the source states; capacity gate = valuation ≥ $1B, listing, or a financing ≥ $500M. Teams are suggested from the FE grid's open lanes (sponsor table) and the company's geography; several prospects may point at the same team — the human layer has not placed anyone.
_meta.columns: Date = the trigger date; Series = FE; Team = suggested FE team; Industry = classline; Person/Role only where the source names the person
_meta.egress_note: The build sandbox could not open most publisher sites directly; sources are the articles the search engine returned and quoted.
